themes.name: AI compute: NVIDIA's supply chain
themes.what: Monday night results split the AI hardware chain. Celestica's revenue rose 83% to $5.83 billion and it raised 2026 guidance to $21.0 billion, but cut free cash flow guidance to $460 million from $600 million; it closed down 5.1% at 246.65 and rose about 9% after hours. Amkor's sales were flat at $1.991 billion and its Q4 guide of $1.9 to $2.0 billion came in below forecasts; it closed down 6.3% at 36.81 (company filings, MoneyCheck, Seeking Alpha).
themes.for_you: No action. CLS (246.65) and AMKR (36.81) are both Wait on Oct 26 closes and in downtrends; AMKR's sellers lead heavily (up/down 0.54). One night's after hours move does not repair a chart.

themes.name: Fintech and Crypto Rails: Stablecoins, Tokenization, Exchanges
themes.what: PayPal reported Q3 on Oct 27: adjusted EPS $1.45 against $1.31 expected, revenue $8.58 billion against $8.71 billion, and a 2026 EPS guide raised to $5.60 from $5.38. Shares were down 0.3% to 2% premarket depending on the report (Investing.com, Benzinga).
themes.for_you: PYPL is left out of both lists: profit is rising from cost cuts while revenue lags. On Oct 26 it slipped from 'Buy zone now' to 'Buy zone, wait for the chart' at 54.99 because sellers lead (up/down 0.94) and the 200 day average is falling. No put idea until it is 'Buy zone now' again.

themes.name: GLP-1 and obesity
themes.what: On Oct 26 a US judge refused Novo Nordisk's request to block Eli Lilly's ads claiming Zepbound beats Wegovy and Mounjaro beats Ozempic, finding no proof of irreparable harm; Novo's lawsuit continues (Reuters via Investing.com, Bloomberg). Lilly already leads in obesity drug sales.
themes.for_you: No action. LLY is 'Accumulate on pullback' at 1279.14, about 4.5% above the top of its zone; NVO has too little data. PFE, on this map, is newly 'Buy zone now' at 29.79 but reports Nov 3.

innovations.name: Financials
innovations.what: SoFi launched SOFIE on Oct 22, which it calls the first national bank issued tokenized deposit for consumers: each token is $1 on deposit at SoFi Bank, FDIC insured, paying 4.40% APY, and can be converted 1:1 into its SoFiUSD stablecoin, which ends the yield and the insurance (SoFi, The Block). Rollout to its crypto customers finishes in November.
innovations.for_you: No action. SOFI is Wait at 14.46 on Oct 26, below its 16.16 to 18.53 zone with sellers leading (up/down 0.73). It shows banks can compete with stablecoins on yield, which matters for CRCL over time.

innovations.name: Materials
innovations.what: Rechecked on the daily rotation. Hexcel reported Q3 on Oct 21: sales about $496 million, up 8.8%, adjusted EPS $0.50 against $0.37, commercial aerospace up about 21% and defense and space down about 9%. It kept 2026 guidance, but shares fell about 11% to 12% as sales missed the roughly $502 million forecast (SEC filing, Investing.com).
innovations.for_you: No action. HXL is Wait at 79.74 on Oct 26, about 35% above the top of its fair value range, with sellers leading (up/down 0.58).

countries.name: Brazil
countries.what: Oct 26 closes: the Ibovespa fell 13.88% to 176,608.23 and the dollar rose 8.21% to R$5.4027 (InfoMoney, Exame); in New York EWZ closed down 19.8% at 34.15, NU 17.0% at 12.59, ITUB 20.4% at 7.70, BBD 28.0% at 2.93, PBR 14.0% at 22.50 and MELI 7.8% at 1668.72 (dashboard). Markets now price a Selic hike in November (InfoMoney). One report says Flavio Bolsonaro dropped his annulment request (SBS), and his party accepts the count (TRT World).
countries.for_you: NU is now Wait, below its 13.10 'thesis broken' line: no buy. EWZ closed 7.7% below a $37 put strike; with no verdict, no roll.

countries.name: Gulf (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Iran risk)
countries.what: After the Oct 26 Tehran meeting, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Pakistan and Iran agreed to keep talking, and one report says Iran would reopen Hormuz within seven days if its conditions are met (Free Press Journal). The same day Iran's Revolutionary Guard declared the strait closed and required ships to use its approved northern corridor, reported by one outlet citing Tasnim (House of Saud). Brent traded near $114.68 early Oct 27 (FinanceFeeds).
countries.for_you: XOM and CVX swings hit their 2R targets on Oct 26; take profits or trail, since both report Oct 30. No name goes in either list: the talks and the Guard's closure pull oil in opposite directions.

countries.name: South Korea
countries.what: The KOSPI rose 3.09% to 5,638.34 on Oct 27, its biggest gain since February, after Anthropic's IPO filing lifted AI stocks; SK hynix rose 5.18% to 1,341,000 won and Samsung 4.23% to 222,000 won, and foreigners bought a net 592.9 billion won (Digital Today, MoneyToday). That reversed a 1.46% drop on Oct 26.
countries.for_you: No action. SK hynix reports at 8pm ET tonight; one day of buying before a report is not a trend. The US listed names are left out of both lists because the move was about the chip makers.
